adds.title: Expungement of Historical Offences Act 2017 (Tas)
adds.summary: In Tasmania since Royal Assent on 21 November 2017, charges and convictions for cross-dressing offences under section 8(1)(d) of the Police Offences Act 1935 as in force before 12 April 2001, including attempts and inciting/instigating/aiding/abetting, are eligible for expungement on application to the Secretary by the charged person or, if deceased or lacking capacity, by specified representatives.
